name: MailPlus Shipmate
author: shipmatedev

sections.description:
MailPlus Shipmate connects WooCommerce stores to the MailPlus Shipmate platform, enabling automated shipping rate calculation and parcel booking.
After linking your MailPlus account, during the checkout, the customer can choose the MailPlus Shipmate service for order delivery. In this case, you can log in to your MailPlus account,
select the appropriate shipping service, check the shipping cost based on weight and delivery time, and finally print and obtain the label.
Store owners can generate shipments, print labels, and track parcels via the MailPlus Shipmate portal.
The plugin uses the MailPlus API to synchronise shipping data and works with WooCommerce shipping zones and delivery settings.
sections.installation:
1. Find MailPlus Shipmate via Woocommerce Extension explorer
  2. Add the MailPlus Shipmate plugin to your shop’s plugin’s list
  3. Click the Activate link and wait
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Setting > Shipping
  5. Click Add zone button
  6. Select your prefered shipping zone and select MailPlus Shipmate from shipping option list
  7. Then on Set up MailPlus Shipmate popup, Click on Connect to MailPlus Shipmate (blue button)
  8. You will be redirected to signup page, also you will be able to login to your MailPlus Shipmate Portal.
